inventory.open: I have a sit-down with my three kitchen managers next week about food cost. Go through this and tell me what I should be paying attention to, with the numbers I should bring.

plain.ask: What was the total value of inventory on hand across the group at the count for the week ending August 16?
plain.how: Pier Nine (P9) kiosk excluded; Magnolia Aug 16 duplicate upload, keep only the Monday re-upload; Bar unit cost is per case of 12, so divide by 12. Value = Count x adjusted Unit Cost.

plain.ask: How much did Ridgeline lose to waste, in dollars, from January through June?
plain.how: RDG and RL are both Ridgeline; reason code 4 (returned to vendor for credit) excluded; Bar unit cost is per case of 12, so divide by 12. By waste Date, Jan 1 to Jun 30, 2026. Value = Qty x adjusted Unit Cost.

plain.ask: What did waste cost the group in July?
plain.how: Pier Nine (P9) kiosk excluded; reason code 4 excluded; Bar unit cost is per case of 12. By waste Date, Jul 1 to Jul 31, 2026. Value = Qty x adjusted Unit Cost.

payroll.open: My banker wants a labor cost summary by branch for January through August for our line of credit renewal. Get this register ready for that and tell me what I should pay attention to.

plain.ask: What did our gross payroll come to for checks dated April through June?
plain.how: KSB is paymaster only (exclude); voids (drop V and the check it voids, keep the M reissue); E0999 is a test employee (exclude). Excludes the two total rows.

plain.ask: How many regular hours did Harrow Point work on checks dated January through March?
plain.how: Old system Reg Hrs includes OT before the April 17 check (subtract OT); RN-FIELD Reg Hrs are visits, not hours (exclude); voids (drop V and the voided original, keep the M reissue).

plain.ask: Which of our branches had the most overtime hours on checks dated January through August, and how many hours?
plain.how: KSB is paymaster only and is not our branch (exclude); this decides the answer. Voids do not change the LNF figure but do change the runner-up (HPT 397.25 with voids handled, 410.25 without). Old rows show branch names, new rows show codes, so names must be mapped to codes.

rentroll.open: I'm sitting down with my accountant next week to close out 2025. Get this ledger and rent roll ready for that meeting and tell me what I should pay attention to.

plain.ask: How much rent and fee money did we actually collect in 2025?
plain.how: F1 (exclude status R payments), F2 (drop the DV-reference June 2025 duplicate copies), F4 (exclude GL 2200 security deposits). Computed as the sum of the Payment column for 2025 rows with status C or P, GL not 2200, and not a DV reference dated before 2025-07-01.

plain.ask: Who owes us the most right now, and how much?
plain.how: F3 (leave out superintendent T20418, who otherwise looks like the top debtor), F1 (T31877's two returned checks still owed; without F1 the top becomes T27730), F2 (June duplicate counted once, or every balance is understated by a month), F4 (deposits not applied to balances). Balance per tenant = all charges minus payments that are C or P, not GL 2200, not June DV duplicates.

plain.ask: What's our total monthly rent coming in from occupied units right now?
plain.how: F3 (the superintendent's unit is occupied but brings in no rent), F5 (keep Alder Court 305 at $425, do not replace with market rent). Computed as the sum of Actual Rent on the Rent Roll for every status except Vacant, excluding tenant T20418.

plain.ask: How much did each hotel spend in July and August 2026?
plain.how: Store spend by hotel for July and August 2026 (CMSY left out)

plain.ask: What rebate should Coastline Provisions owe us on 2025 purchases?

finance.open: I'm taking over this financial model. What should I be paying attention to, and is it ready to show the board?

plain.ask: Which formulas in the model look like mistakes?
plain.how: Balance Sheet!AF5; P&L!AB9; Revenue!X5. New MRR in Nov 2027 multiplies by churn instead of Growth, G&A in Mar 2028 drops the fixed G&A, and AR in Jul 2028 points at the prior month's revenue.

plain.ask: What does the Growth input mean?
plain.how: Month over month growth of MRR: each forecast month adds Growth x beginning MRR as New MRR (4% per month, not per year).

plain.ask: What's our lowest cash month?
plain.how: $934,948.55 in Feb 2027, the month before the planned Series B lands.
